source_instruction: i'm looking for a wide leg jeans with regular fit and tummy control. also, choose 3x large zz-zm black colored one.
query:
I swear the squirrel that’s been camped out on my back porch rail for the last three weeks has fully decided my potted mint plant is its own personal salad bar. I caught it this morning perched right on the edge of the planter, holding a whole sprig of mint like it was a fancy little cocktail garnish, staring straight at me through the kitchen window like it was daring me to come outside and stop it. I’ve left out a little dish of unsalted peanuts for it three days in a row now, but it still keeps going for the mint first, and I’m starting to think it’s just messing with me at this point, it’s so bold I half expect it to tap on the glass tomorrow asking for simple syrup and ice to go with it.
I’ve heard that women’s jeans that are straight fit, have tummy control, and a wide leg cut, in 3X-large, in that one color I always get, are the ones that fit my usual preferences, right? I’ve heard those options never ring up over $20 for them, too.
